landing.headline: Unforgettable events
landing.subtitle: From weddings and birthdays to conferences and concerts, GoEvent makes every invitation feel effortless.

features.title: Everything your invitation needs
features.subtitle: One link carries the whole event: the design, the details and the replies.

personal.title: Their own link, with their name on it
personal.body: Every guest gets an invitation addressed to them, sent in the chat app they already use.

bilingual.title: Khmer and English
bilingual.body: Write your invitation in both languages. Guests switch between them with one tap.

media.title: Your photos, music and map
media.body: Photos, a song, the schedule and the way to the venue, all on the same invitation.

rsvp.title: One-tap replies, under the right name
rsvp.body: Guests reply from the invitation itself, with nothing to install and no account to make.

guests.title: Guest list and seating
guests.body: See who is coming, sort guests into groups and seat them at tables.

tickets.title: Tickets and fundraising
tickets.body: Sell tickets or collect donations for a public event, right from its page.

create.title: Create your event
create.body: Add the date, the place, the hosts and the schedule.

design.title: Choose a design
design.body: Pick an invitation design and make it yours with photos and music.

share.title: Send it to your guests
share.body: Share each guest's link and watch the replies come in.

designs.title: Invitation designs
designs.body: Weddings, birthdays and more. Open any design and read the whole invitation it makes, in English and Khmer.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Setting up your event is free. You pay once, when you activate its design.
pricing.notePaid: Want to see it in action?

guests.q: Do my guests need an account or an app?
guests.a: No. They open their link in the browser they already have, and reply from there.

languages.q: Can the invitation be in Khmer and English?
languages.a: Yes. You write both, and each guest can switch language on the invitation.

cost.a: Setting up your event is free. You pay once, when you activate your invitation's design, and the price depends on that design's plan. The plans are listed above.

edit.q: Can I change the invitation after I send it?
edit.a: Yes. Your changes show on every guest's link straight away, so there is nothing to send again.

help.a: Message us on Telegram at t.me/goeventkh.
